meta.executedQueryString:
select   host as full_name, 
        case 
          when 'if_octets' = 'if_octets' then 'decbytes' 
          when 'if_octets' = 'if_packets' then 'prepackets' 
          else  'sishort' end as Unit, 
        sum("if_octets")  as total
        
from ( 

  select  distinct  "4/6/key_as_string" as time,
          "4/5/key" as "host" , 
          cast("3/value" as double) + cast("66/value" as double) if_packets, 
          cast("4/value" as double) + cast("7/value" as double) if_octets
  FROM TABLE(
      quickwit.system.raw_query(
      "query" => '*',
      "qwindex" =>'flows3',
      "columns" => '4/6/key_as_string,4/5/key,3/value,66/value,4/value,7/value',
      "replacefromcolumns" => '/6/buckets/5/buckets/9/buckets/',
      "hasjs" => 'true',
      "start_timestamp" => '1778783640',
      "end_timestamp" => '1778787240',
      "aggs" => '[
            histogram(field=span_start_timestamp_nanos, interval=144h, min=1, id=6),

            terms(field=span_attributes.i, size=5, order=id:1:desc, min=1, id=5),

            min(field=span_attributes.t, id=1),

            terms(field=span_attributes.i, size=9999, order=id:3:desc, min=1, id=9),

            sum(field=span_attributes.t, id=3),
            sum(field=span_attributes.u, id=4),
            sum(field=span_attributes.ab, id=66),
            sum(field=span_attributes.ac, id=7),
            count(field=span_attributes.u, id=55)
          ]'
      )) as i
      where "4/6/key_as_string"  is not null


  -- select  distinct  "4/6/key_as_string" as time,
  --         "4/5/key" as "host" , 
  --         cast("3/value" as double) + cast("6/value" as double) if_packets, 
  --         cast("4/value" as double) + cast("7/value" as double) if_octets
  -- from quickwit.otlp_metric."" as i 
) as r 
group by host
order by total desc
limit 5
